line: A crocodile lairs in the shallows under our plank walk. It took a raft. No one on the crew will take a raft out now.
The plank walk runs along the shore beside our houses. The beast lies in the water beneath it.
Kill it. Then we can work the river again. I ask no more of you than that.
I am glad you asked, friend. A crocodile lairs in the shallows under our plank walk. It took one of our rafts.
Now no one on the crew will take a raft out. The walk runs along the shore beside our houses. The beast lies in the water beneath it.
Will you kill it for us? I trust you with this. Then we can work the river again.
